topic: Quality assurance in Indian Navy, station / Carrier / yard QA cell – organisation, manpower, duties and responsibilities.

specific_objectives: 5.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the concept of quality assurance, control and indigenization.

intro_questions: What is the primary difference between quality assurance and quality control?
Define the concept of indigenization in naval engineering.
Why is a dedicated QA cell necessary in a naval station or carrier?
